ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram has three separate food chain combinations. On the left, arrows from flowers and grass point to rabbit, and an arrow from rabbit points to fox. In the middle, an arrow from wheat points to field mice, and an arrow from field mice points to hawk. On the right, an arrow from fruit trees points to deer, and an arrow from deer points to bear. Reasoning: The arrows indicate the relationship from food source to consumer. fruit trees are directly consumed by or relied on by deer; if most fruit trees are destroyed, the main food source of deer would decrease, so the deer population would greatly decrease.
